decisions.decision: The ANR plan for 26/30/34 Laurel Lane is to be distributed for department, commission and board review.
decisions.quote: plan will be distributed for department/commission/board review.

decisions.decision: A. Burney is to notify the applicant of the Szocik ANR decision.
The Board will take a vote at its January 12, 2015 meeting on whether the Housing Production Plan is sent to the state.
decisions.quote: board members will take a vote at their january 12, 2015 meeting as to the hpp being sent to the state.

decisions.decision: A handout will be prepared for Town Meeting so residents can understand the iterations the Village Center District has gone through.
decisions.quote: a handout will be available at town meeting for the residents to understand the various iterations

decisions.decision: The Board would like a formal request sent to the School Committee on the intent of the line.
decisions.quote: board would like a formal request to go to the school committee as to the intent of the line.

decisions.decision: Interested Planning Board members should attend a School Committee meeting rather than a joint meeting being set up with the Planning Board.
decisions.quote: interested planning board members should attend a school committee meeting

decisions.decision: The Historical Commission will provide its initial draft of the architectural preservation district to A. Burney for input.
decisions.quote: the historical commission will provide its initial draft to a. burney for input.

decisions.decision: Draft 5 of the Village Center District bylaw will be updated with final edits for the January 12, 2015 meeting, and the January 26 meeting will be a citizen listening session.
decisions.quote: draft 5 will be updated with finals edits for the board's january 12, 2015 meeting.
